description: This file defines the class 'FieldInfo', a container representing a field with an associated name and type, including methods for generating a combined identifier and normalizing the type.

classes.name: FieldInfo
classes.description: Represents a field with a name and type, providing methods to retrieve a combined name/type string and normalize the type.

methods.name: FieldInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the field's name and type.

methods.name: getNameAndType
methods.description: Returns a combined string of the field's name and normalized type, caching the result.

methods.name: normalizeType
methods.description: Normalizes the field's type to its binary name using the provided ApiList, updating internal state if normalization occurs.
